hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Define F(s)=y+s*(m-y)/(sig2+tau2). Then G0001=F(sig2), G0002=dF/ds(sig2), G0003=F(sig2), G0004=F(sig2)-F(sig2)=0.
hypotheses.rationale: Structurally, all four expressions are generated by the same affine interpolant in a scaled coordinate s. G0003 simplifies algebraically to G0001; G0002 is the derivative of the interpolant with respect to s at s=sig2; G0004 is the difference of two evaluations of the same value and therefore vanishes. No physical interpretation is invoked.
